Five Indian Seafarers Rescued After Tanker Hit by Projectile

Five Indian nationals were rescued after the Kuwait-flagged tanker MT Kazimah III was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. The Indian Embassy in Oman coordinated the rescue of the seafarers, who were brought ashore safely in Oman. The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported the incident involving an unknown projectile off Oman.
